# Nacim Rached

> Nacim Rached (نسيم راشد, also spelled Nassim Rached) is a full-stack and mobile developer based in Tunisia, working remotely. He builds React Native and Expo mobile apps, React and Next.js web products, and TypeScript/Node.js and PHP/Laravel backends. He holds a Master's in Mobile Development Engineering from the Higher Institute of Management of Gabès (ISG Gabès).

## Skills

TypeScript, React, React Native, Expo, Android, iOS, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, Laravel, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, Stripe, PayPal, MapLibre, C

## Projects

- [Kariaa](https://kariaa.onrender.com/): Map-first rental platform for Tunisia — PostGIS search, price pins on MapLibre, POI radius filters, Next.js monorepo with a mobile app.
- [PiggyPower](https://piggypower.vercel.app): CHP thermoelectric e-commerce — Next.js storefront with Stripe Payment Element, PayPal checkout, and server-side price validation.
- [UseMyPc](https://usemyypc.vercel.app): Control your desktop from a phone — remote desktop experience with a TypeScript web layer and native C companion.
- Abdelmoula RH: HR management for Abdelmoula Agency — workers, payroll, CNSS, leaves, calendar, and notifications in PHP.
- Abdelmoula Véhicules: Fleet and vehicle ops dashboard — leasing, mileage, expenses, stock pieces, travel tours, and notifications in PHP.
- Abdelmoula Camp: Full desert-camp ops system for a travel agency — multi-role auth, complex reservations (tents, 4x4s, drivers, guides), tariff engine with kids & New Year pricing, boarding, services, payments, schedules, receipts, EN/FR, and PWA install on LAN.
- [E-commerce](https://e-commerce-nacims.vercel.app): Freelance storefront with a full shopping flow, built end-to-end in TypeScript and shipped on Vercel.
- Gestion Événement: Event management platform on Laravel — auth, sessions, Blade UI, and real event workflows.
- AL-ASSALA: Graduation e-commerce build — catalog, cart, and commerce flows for a complete PFE deliverable.
- [TALAAWIN](https://github.com/nassim778/TALAAWIN): GeoGuess Tunisian edition — guess locations across Tunisia. Android APK available.
- [nassinet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nassinet): CLI speed tester — latency, download, upload, then a 0–100 connection score. Run with `npx nassinet`.
